sources.summary: Bamboo-clad parasols and a three-storey bamboo truss feature in this roundup of buildings from Southeast and South Asia built using the fast-growing plant. Mahamudra Meditation Centre, Nepal, by Abari A mandala-shaped bamboo truss crowns this Buddhist meditation centre in Tibet, Nepal, which is perched atop a mountain near the country's capital, Kathmandu. Designed by architecture The post Seven buildings that demonstrate the versatility of bamboo appeared first on Dezeen .
